# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 22 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_022_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 22

**22:1** Now Herod was searching for John and sent officers to Zechariah at the altar, saying to him, "Where have you hidden your son?" And he answered and said to them, "I am a minister of God and attend upon his temple. I know not where my son is."

**22:2** And the officers departed and told Herod everything. And Herod was angry and said, "His son is to become king of Israel." And he sent to him again, saying, "Tell the truth. Where is your son? You know that your blood is under my hand." And the officers went and told him these things.

**22:3** And Zechariah said, "I am a martyr of God. Take my blood. But the Lord will receive my spirit, for innocent blood you will shed at the entrance of the temple of the Lord."

**22:4** And toward the break of day Zechariah was slain. And the children of Israel did not know that he had been slain.
